summary: Frontend testing of 4 Sala Sitor features (Lingua Coerente, Turni sulla Plancia, Avviso Ritardo, Assegna Mirata) on preview https://edit-33.preview.emergentagent.com. All features implemented correctly. Live board data at test time: totals={total:5, busy:5, free:0, on_shift:2, later:3, late:1}. Michele late (+22/+23'). Ahmed/Sara/Luca show 'Più tardi · lun'. Antonio on shift, busy. Assign-pick buttons only render for free+on-shift operators; since all 5 were busy, the picker UI itself wasn't opened via UI — but the underlying API GET /api/worker/pending-steps returned 200 with 12 steps as spec allows. Language switching works perfectly in both directions: IT keeps IT, EN keeps EN, no leakage.
critical_code_review_comments: OperatorStatusBoard.jsx (201 lines) is clean and covers all 4 features with proper data-testid coverage.
LanguageContext.jsx correctly prioritizes saved localStorage lang over URL segment and browser lang (fix confirmed).

MINOR: GET /api/worker/board response does not include task_id/step_order on busy operators — this prevents the frontend (or a tester) from directly completing a running task through the standard endpoint (POST /api/worker/task-action returned 404 'Nessun task per l'operatore' because payload lacked task_id). Not a blocker for the 4 features under test, but consider exposing task_id/step_order in the board payload for parity with worker-facing endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow: POST /api/admin-gate/verify {pin:198505} + POST /api/auth/login, then set localStorage.mikilab_admin_unlocked=1 + mikilab_onboarded=1 + mikilab_activity=panificio + mikilab_lang=it/en, then goto('/'). Do NOT use wait_until='networkidle' with page.reload — the SSE/polling endpoints keep the network busy and Playwright times out; use 'domcontentloaded' + page.wait_for_timeout(4-5s). Sala Sitor is on the landing page; scrollIntoView on [data-testid=sala-sitor]. If you need a free operator to exercise assign-pick UI, board payload lacks task_id — you may seed a free operator server-side or reset the test DB.

test_results_detail.T4_assegna_mirata: PARTIAL PASS (spec-compliant fallback) — All 5 operators were busy at test time, so board-assign-pick-* buttons were not rendered (correct behavior per code: only for !busy && !locked_by_capo && !off). Per spec, verified fallback: GET /api/worker/pending-steps → 200 with steps.length=12. The picker code path is present and well-formed (assign-picker modal with assign-picker-close, assign-picker-step-N, POST /api/worker/assign-step wiring). Could not exercise the click flow through UI because there is no server-visible way to free an operator (board payload lacks task_id).
test_results_detail.no_regressions: Console UI still in italian, Sala Sitor section visible, sitor-tour renders, delegation modal available, no console errors seen during the runs.
